raw_segments.text: She said it so finally, and in such an undiscussable way, that Mr. Pumblechook, though in a condition
of ruffled dignity, could not protest.
But he eyed me severely, as if I had done anything to him, and departed with the words
Boy, let your behavior here be a credit unto them which brought you up by hand.
I was not free from apprehension that he would come back to propound through the gate.
